title: Baked feta pasta
ingredients: Few garlic cloves in baking dish
instructions: Put 2 pint cherry tomatoes toss with olive oil and few garlic cloves in baking dish with one block of feta, basil, salt, pepper
Add cooked pasta and pasta water and combine
notes: Original Doc Shorthand: Put 2 pint cherry tomatoes toss with olive oil and few garlic cloves in baking dish with one block of feta, basil, salt, pepper — Bake 400 for 30 - 35 mins — Mash with fork — Add cooked pasta and pasta water and combine
